intro.title: Marketing translation that reads as if it was written locally
paras: Commercial texts need translators who respect the terminology and register of the original. Whether it is translating press releases, brochures or international campaigns, the result has to be readable, effective and culturally sensitive.
BeTranslated has provided translation services to a range of international companies, in the languages their audiences actually speak.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: It adapts your message for a new audience rather than converting words one by one.
The translator often rewrites the text with the target culture in mind.
Which marketing documents can you translate?
Presentations, press releases, catalogues, surveys, packaging, media kits, brochures and websites, among others.
If your file is not listed, ask us.
Why not use a literal translation?
Cultural references and plays on words rarely carry over directly.
A marketing specialist adapts them without changing the original message.
How do I get a quote?
Send the material, the languages you need and your deadline.
We reply with a free, no-obligation quote.
